ACCESSIBLE_BUS_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find departures meeting explicitly recorded accessibility requirements.

AC_BUS_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find services whose assigned vehicle or configuration explicitly supports air conditioning.

ALIGHTING_POINT.definition: Identify permitted drop-off locations or validate a requested alighting station on a selected service.

ALTERNATIVE_ROUTES.definition: Find different feasible paths or transfer patterns for the same journey, relative to an optional selected route.

ARRIVAL_TIME.definition: Retrieve the scheduled arrival time for the selected service and stop, labelling any operational override separately.

AVAILABLE_BUS_TYPES.definition: List the service classifications represented by eligible departures on the requested segment.

BOARDING_POINT.definition: Identify locations at which passengers may board the selected service or destination-bound journey.

BOOKING_OPTIONS.definition: Describe locally recorded approved ticket booking channels and instructions without executing a purchase.

BOOKING_STATUS.definition: Read status of an existing booking only when an authorized local record is available; otherwise report unsupported or unavailable.

BUSES_BETWEEN.definition: List scheduled services permitting boarding at the origin and later alighting at the destination.

BUSES_OPERATING_TODAY.definition: Check which services operate on the station-local current date using calendars and exceptions.

BUS_AMENITIES.definition: Report verified amenities of the selected assigned vehicle, retaining unknown feature states.

BUS_ARRIVED_STATUS.definition: Confirm arrival only from an authoritative actual-arrival event at the specified stop.

BUS_AT_TIME.definition: Find departures within a documented tolerance window around a specified clock time.

BUS_CANCELLATION.definition: Confirm operational cancellation of a specific service occurrence, not a passenger's ticket cancellation request.

BUS_CAPACITY.definition: Report physical seat and berth capacity of the assigned configuration, not vacant inventory.

BUS_DELAY.definition: Report a verified delay duration or recorded reason for the selected dated trip and affected stop.

BUS_DEPARTED_STATUS.definition: Confirm departure only from an authoritative actual-departure event at the specified stop.

BUS_PLATFORM.definition: Report the currently valid confirmed station bay assignment for a specific dated trip.

BUS_VIA_LOCATION.definition: Check or search for a route passing through a requested via point without asserting a passenger halt.

CANCELLATION_POLICY.definition: Explain locally stored passenger ticket cancellation terms, independently of operational trip cancellation.

CHEAPEST_BUS.definition: Rank eligible services by known applicable segment fare; missing prices are never zero.

COMPLAINT_GUIDANCE.definition: Explain the locally recorded complaint or grievance channel and reporting instructions.

CONCESSION_ENQUIRY.definition: Explain date-effective concession schemes and explicit eligibility requirements without assuming passenger qualification.

CONNECTING_BUSES.definition: Find feasible time-ordered multi-leg journeys respecting transfer windows and stop permissions.

DEPARTURES_AFTER.definition: Find eligible departures following an explicitly supplied lower time bound.

DEPARTURES_BEFORE.definition: Find eligible departures preceding an explicitly supplied upper time bound.

DESTINATION_REACHABILITY.definition: Determine whether any feasible direct or connecting bus itinerary reaches the requested destination in the search period.

DIRECT_BUS.definition: Find a single service allowing the requested journey without a vehicle change.

ELECTRIC_BUS_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find services with an explicitly assigned electric vehicle or configuration.

ESTIMATED_ARRIVAL.definition: Report a fresh verified operational arrival estimate; a scheduled arrival alone does not satisfy this intent.

FARE_COMPARISON.definition: Compare applicable prices for multiple services or categories on the same boarding segment and travel date.

FASTEST_BUS.definition: Rank eligible services by elapsed journey duration for the same requested segment.

FIRST_BUS.definition: Find the earliest departure within one explicitly selected operating day, independent of the current time.

GET_FARE.definition: Retrieve an applicable date-effective fare for the actual boarding and alighting segment and selected service or category.

INTERMEDIATE_STOP.definition: Confirm whether a selected service actually calls at a specific intermediate station and allows the relevant passenger action.

JOURNEY_DURATION.definition: Calculate travel duration between the passenger's valid boarding and alighting stops.

LAST_BUS.definition: Find the final eligible departure inside the chosen calendar or operator-defined operating-day bounds.

LIVE_BUS_STATUS.definition: Report the freshest authoritative operational state or location, distinguishing scheduled-only, stale and unknown data.

LOST_PROPERTY.definition: Provide the locally recorded lost-property reporting contact or procedure without claiming an item was found.

LUGGAGE_RULES.definition: Describe recorded baggage allowances, restrictions and applicable published luggage charges.

NEXT_BUS.definition: Find the earliest eligible departures after the passenger's requested threshold, including later operating dates.

NON_AC_BUS_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find services explicitly known to be non-air-conditioned, excluding unknown configurations.

OPERATOR_CONTACT.definition: Provide published local operator or depot contact information relevant to the passenger's service.

PLATFORM_CHANGE.definition: Confirm a platform reassignment by examining assignment history for the same trip and station.

REFUND_POLICY.definition: Explain applicable recorded refund rules or a supported calculation; never infer a refund without required policy data.

RESERVATION_SUPPORTED.definition: Report whether reservations are supported for the selected service, separately from current seat availability.

ROUTE_DISTANCE.definition: Retrieve sourced cumulative or segment distance along the applicable route variant.

ROUTE_STOPS.definition: Retrieve the ordered scheduled stopping pattern of the selected route variant or service.

SEATER_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find services with verified seater accommodation rather than inferring layout from category branding.

SEAT_AVAILABILITY.definition: Report fresh segment-specific inventory for a dated trip and requested seat count, distinguishing unknown and stale states.

SERVICE_CATEGORY_COMPARISON.definition: Explain recorded differences between two or more service categories without guaranteeing vehicle amenities.

SERVICE_DISRUPTION.definition: Report verified diversions, suspensions or other incidents effective for the requested service or period.

SERVICE_FREQUENCY.definition: Describe scheduled departure counts or intervals on a segment within a specified period, without assuming regular headways.

SERVICE_NUMBER_LOOKUP.definition: Resolve a service identifier within operator and validity scope, requesting clarification if multiple records match.

SLEEPER_AVAILABILITY.definition: Find services with verified sleeping berths, independently of branded category and seat inventory.

SPECIAL_DAY_SCHEDULE.definition: Retrieve date-specific extra or changed schedules for a specified holiday, festival or special operating date.

STATION_FACILITIES.definition: Report locally recorded passenger facilities and their verification or availability state at a station.

STATION_HELPDESK.definition: Provide a recorded station enquiry/helpdesk contact, location or opening information.

STATION_NAVIGATION.definition: Provide recorded within-station directions or zone information without inventing an indoor route.

findings: Sparse support per class, not missing 60-class output coverage
Old TextCNN trained with 234 texts and 60 outputs; vocabulary/sequence configuration far exceeds effective supervision
Original trainer records nfkc-casefold preprocessing metadata but passes raw strings to estimators; normalize explicitly in recovery corpus
Standalone SVM forces OOS into a transport label; use validation-only rejection calibration
Boarding versus platform, arrival schedule versus live ETA, facilities versus navigation, policy versus action, direct versus reachability require contrastive boundaries
Existing generated record count is not semantic family diversity; preserve grouping and count eligible classifier rows
No independent human-reviewed test set; no promotion conclusion from synthetic metrics
